title: ISV publish readiness runbook and snippet bank
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact runbook for publishing Redwood Inference as an ISV offering across cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP). It focuses on acceptance gates, the minimal asset set, copy variants for listings, and a lightweight QA checklist that publisher/product teams can run without engineering deep-dives.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: GTM, Product Listing owners, Partner Ops, Technical PMs supporting marketplace onboarding.
- Scope: listing copy, required assets, metadata mapping, acceptance tests, billing/SKU notes, and a short snippet bank for common placement (short blurb, 2-line description, feature bullets).

High-level acceptance gates (must pass all):
1) Security/compliance: validated DSR process, up-to-date SOC/KMS notes, link to security pack (CONFLUENCE-1234).
2) Billing/SKU: SKU mapped and verified with finance (JIRA-OPS-879).
3) Assets: icon (512x512 PNG), header image (1600x400), 2 customer logos with permission, 3 screenshots or animated GIFs demonstrating console flows.
4) Copy: short blurb, 250-word overview, 3 feature bullets, 3 pricing calls-to-action.
5) Integration tests: sample API call working in partner sandbox and example curl/SDK snippet in markdown.
6) Legal: T&Cs and privacy pointer included, approved by legal.

Minimal asset checklist (quick):
- Company logo (square, 512px)
- Listing banner (1600x400) + alternate (1200x300)
- 3 product screenshots annotated with captions
- 2 customer logos + short quote (<=40 words) + attribution
- Contact and support link (support@redwood.ai or partner portal)

Metadata mapping (fields to confirm):
- Category: AI Platform / Inference / Dev Tools
- Use cases: text generation, embeddings, private deployment
- Regions: US-EAST1, EU-WEST1 (confirm availability)
- Pricing model: usage-per-token + monthly reserved capacity SKU for Dedicated
- Tags: llm, inference, low-latency, private-deploy

Copy snippet bank (pick one per slot, keep variations):
Short blurb (<= 180 chars):
- "Scale production LLM inference with predictable latency and cost — hosted, dedicated, or private deployments."
- "High-throughput LLM inference with rollout controls and cost-aware optimizations for engineering teams."

2-line overview (for hero area):
- "Redwood Inference provides a single API and ops surface to run LLM inference consistently across hosted, reserved, and private deployments. Built for production SLAs, cost visibility, and fast rollouts."
- "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and unit economics. Automatic batching, KV caching, and model routing make serving reliable and affordable."

Feature bullets (short):
- "Hosted API and SDKs for quick integration"
- "Reserved Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed throughput"
- "Private deployment options (VPC/on‑prem) with KMS integrations"

CTA variants (choose depending on marketplace UX):
- "Get started — free credits"
- "Request Dedicated capacity"
- "Contact sales for enterprise/private deployments"

UX/Content notes (practical):
- Keep first sentence benefit-focused: what operational problem does this solve? Avoid architecture-first language.
- Prefer active verbs "Ship", "Reduce", "Control" over nouns.
- Include a one-line example (curl + short expected output) in the Technical details tab.

Quick QA checklist (pre-submission):
- [ ] Banner and icon render on mobile and desktop (mock test)
- [ ] All external links resolve (support, privacy, docs)
- [ ] Pricing table aligns with SKU and is represented in two places (pricing tab + listing brief)
- [ ] Contact email is monitored and routes to partner ops
- [ ] SDK/curl sample executes in partner sandbox environment

Launch timeline (compressed):
- Day 0: Assets assembled; legal sign off requested
- Day 2: Internal review (GTM + Product) and sample runs
- Day 4: Submit to marketplace; track submission id and reviewer notes
- Day 14: Expect initial feedback; iterate on reviewer comments

Owner and contacts:
- Listing owner: Lena Chen (GTM) — lena@redwood.ai
- Technical contact: Marco Alvarez — marco@redwood.ai
- Finance/SKU: Priya Nair — priya@redwood.ai

Open questions / TODOs (short):
- Confirm region availability for customer-managed private deployments (ask infra-team slack #private-deploy).
- Decide which 2 customer logos to display — need logo release forms.
- Finalize reserved capacity SKU naming with finance (JIRA-OPS-879).

Reviewer checklist for post-acceptance (what to do when listing goes live):
- Add listing link to public docs and product pages
- Sync tracking in GA and marketplace analytics (set UTM and campaign IDs)
- Prepare short launch post for partner comms (1-paragraph + screenshot)

Notes to self (fragmented, save early):
- If reviewer requests more technical detail, point them to the private deployment quickstart (CONFLUENCE-1234).
- Keep two alternate hero images (one focused on latency/cost graph, one showing console).

End.
